title: Summer Olympics: hosts and who topped the table
intro: Every Summer Games of the last twenty years and the next one: where they were held, and which country finished top of the medal table.
dataNote: Hosts and years are settled. Gold counts are given only where two sources agreed: for London 2012 our sources split between 46 and 48 golds for the United States, so the number is left out rather than guessed — the country that finished top is not in doubt, the figure is.

tables.title: The Games
rows: China — 48 golds, the only host to top the table in this span
United States — the gold count is disputed between our sources, so it is not stated here
United States — 39 golds to China's 38. Held in 2021 after being postponed
United States and China tied on 40 golds; the United States finished top on silvers
